messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service=auth-service severity=page — alert: token validation error rate >5% (us-east-1). https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-3054 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: INC-3054 triggered by metric auth.token_validate.error_rate > 5% (5m). Assigned to oncall-robert. Escalation policy: standard 3-tier.
oncall-robert: ack — I'm on. pulling logs and checking jwks cache across regions.
oncall-robert: quick snapshot from auth-proxy logs (us-east-1):
```
2026-03-14T14:01:02Z ERROR token_verify failed kid=oldKeyId not found, user_id=null request=/api/v1/login 401
2026-03-14T14:01:08Z ERROR token_verify failed kid=oldKeyId not found, user_id=null request=/api/v1/session 401
```
oncall-robert: ran curl against jwks endpoint for auth-service in us-east:
```
curl -s https://auth-us-east.internal/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'
"newKeyId"
```
(oncall-robert) — JWKS only shows the new key, old kid missing. likely rotation propagation issue.
infra-eli: +1 — looks like the key-rotation job replaced the JWKS and the previous key wasn't retained; CDN/edge cache likely holding an older copy or TTL mis-set so some signers/clients still sending tokens with old kid.
support-jen: support intake: 23 customer tickets in last 12m mentioning 401 / login failures. Major customers: AcmeCorp, BrightRetail. CS escalations coming. posting status page note now.
sre-danielle: propose immediate mitigations (short list):
  1) enable signing-fallback on auth-service to accept previous key for 15m
  2) purge JWKS cache on CDN + edge caches
  3) if problems persist, rollback rotation job to re-add old key to JWKS
Can someone run 1 & 2?
oncall-robert: applying signing-fallback via configmap patch now (k8s cluster auth-prod):
```
kubectl -n platform patch configmap auth-signing-config -p '{"data":{"accept_previous_key":"true","previous_key_ttl":"15m"}}'
```
oncall-robert: patch applied — auth pods reloaded config (rolling restart triggered).
incident-bot: action logged: configmap patched by oncall-robert at 2026-03-14T14:07:12Z.
infra-eli: purging jwks cache on CDN (fastly) — running purge by key: auth-us-east-jwks.
infra-eli: fastly purge API response: {"status":"ok","id":"purge-9a8b"} — edge caches receiving purge.
oncall-robert: monitoring metrics — token validation error rate dropping:
  14:01 -> 12.3%
  14:06 -> 4.1%
  14:09 -> 0.9%
support-jen: ticket volume stabilizing, two major customers reported successful logins after ~6m. updating status page: "Partial outage affecting auth token validation in US-East; mitigations in progress."
sre-danielle: good, keep an eye on any remaining 401 spikes and long-tail retry errors. we should also capture exact rotation timestamps and the rotation service logs for postmortem.
oncall-robert: note for handoff: rotation initiated by key-rotation-service at 2026-03-14T13:59:58Z; rotation job finished at 14:01:05Z. looks like previous key removal was intentional but the publish step didn't include a short overlap window. leaving logs and commands in #inc-3054-notes.
maria: 30m until my shift — I'll take over monitoring/coordination and follow up with key-management. @oncall-robert please leave a short runbook and the commands you ran.
oncall-robert: handoff: added runbook snippet to thread — summary: enabled accept_previous_key=true, purged CDN cache, confirmed JWKS now contains both newKeyId and oldKeyId for 10m window. continuing to watch metrics for 30m.
support-jen: sent proactive messages to top affected customers; CS will escalate any new P1s to this channel.
maria: ack — taking over. next steps I'm driving: verify key-rotation service patch to enforce overlap (publish both old+new for 15m), run a dry-run of rotation in staging, and schedule postmortem. also coordinate with infra to add automated JWKS cache invalidation to rotation job.
oncall-robert: thanks team — handing off. logging out. :wave: :thumbsup:
pagerduty: Incident INC-3054 acknowledged by oncall-robert at 2026-03-14T14:05:23Z. Status: acknowledged -> monitoring.
incident-bot: Incident INC-3054 marked resolved by oncall-maria at 2026-03-14T14:28:35Z after 27 minutes of steady metrics below threshold. Closing page. :white_check_mark:
maria: closing notes: root cause = key-rotation service removed previous key without overlap; contributing factor = CDN cache TTL + missing purge step. Severity = P1 (customer impact on logins). Follow-ups: postmortem + rollout change + automated purge + add integration test for JWKS overlap. assigning action owners in PM board.
support-jen: updating tickets: adding resolution note and follow-up link to postmortem when available. customers notified.
sre-danielle: will run an after-action review and draft postmortem, assigning root cause and remediation tasks. thanks everyone for fast response. :heart:
maria: resolved for now — monitoring window complete. handoff complete. :lock:
